# pdf417-structured-origins-1

Black = matching ink; magenta = printer only; cyan = library only. Compact previews share a common origin and crop only trailing blank space; click for the full-resolution image. Scores always use uncropped original pixels.

Printer and Labelary captures retain their original capture dates. Local renders are cached independently; execution timestamps are recorded per result in results.json.

[Corpus comparisons](../features/README.md) · [All accuracy comparisons](../../README.md)

FM structured append origins; insufficient origins may intentionally suppress symbols

[ZPL source](../../../../../test-data/render-conformance/cases/barcode-arguments/pdf417-structured-origins-1.zpl)

Validity: boundary.
